claimId: 9ea0a7398c8b
said: 2016-10-19 (Tesla Autopilot 2.0 press call (reported by TechCrunch))
deadline: 2017

transitions.label: pushed_later
transitions.note: The self-driving milestone moved from a coast-to-coast drive in 2017 to a million robotaxis by the end of 2020.

transitions.label: pushed_later
transitions.note: The target moved from a million robotaxis by 2020 to a paid unsupervised service in Austin in June 2025.

transitions.label: reaffirmed
transitions.note: A June 2025 milestone again: a car driving itself from the factory to a customer on June 28.

transitions.label: escalated
transitions.note: Moved from one car driving itself to a customer (a milestone that was met) to ride-hailing for about half the US population by the end of 2025.
